name: ai-native-sdlc
description: Enforces the Anthropic Academy AI-native SDLC playbook as deterministic hooks: artifact chain (intent/spec/plan), test-lock during fixes, credential and protected-path guards, production release gate, and verification-before-done. Skills carry the knowledge; hooks carry the enforcement.

enforcement_level.title: Enforcement level
enforcement_level.description: advisory = level-dependent gates warn only; standard = they block (default); strict = additionally requires a plan before any source edit. The always-hard set (credentials, production deploy, protected branches, test lock, protected paths, approved exits, config self-protection) ignores this setting entirely.

hard_hooks_locked.title: Lock the always-hard gates
hard_hooks_locked.description: When true (default), repository configuration cannot downgrade any always-hard gate. Set false only to debug the plugin itself.

sdlc_config_path.title: Repository config path
sdlc_config_path.description: Path, relative to the repository root, of the version-controlled policy file this plugin reads. Everything repo-specific lives there, not here.

release_approval_env.title: Release authorization variable
release_approval_env.description: Name of the environment variable carrying a named release authorization. A session cannot write its own hook process environment, so the agent cannot forge it — but a human sets it, so it is an attributable assertion rather than authentication. Block messages say so.

release_approval_route.title: Route to release approval
release_approval_route.description: Free text naming who grants a release authorization and how, inserted verbatim into the block message (Lesson 11: a block must explain itself and the route to approval).

release_gate_mode.title: Release gate mode
release_gate_mode.description: deny (default) or warn. Never 'ask': an approval prompt puts a human on the critical path of every parallel session and deadlocks non-interactive runs.

organization_policy_url.title: Organization policy URL
organization_policy_url.description: Optional link appended to block messages so an engineer can read the source policy behind a gate.

log_retention_days.title: Decision ledger retention (days)
log_retention_days.description: SessionStart prunes decision ledger files older than this.

telemetry_forward_command.title: Ledger forwarding command
telemetry_forward_command.description: Optional command run at SessionEnd to ship the decision ledger to an observability stack. Empty means the ledger stays on this machine.

probe_sensitive_value.title: PHASE 0 PROBE — sensitive value
probe_sensitive_value.description: TEMPORARY. Exists only to answer plan assumption B: are `sensitive: true` userConfig values exported to hook processes as CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_*? Set it to any non-empty string during Phase 0, then delete this key. Its value is never logged.
